name: Ring Battery Doorbell 2K Plus (US)

radios.note: Ring's support page lists dual-band 2.4 and 5 GHz (802.11 a/b/g/n/ax).

matter.note: No Matter claim on Ring's pages and no CSA listing was found.

apple_home.note: Ring's pages for this doorbell don't mention Apple Home or HomeKit.

google_home.note: No Ring page found listing Google Home for this doorbell.

alexa.note: Ring's support page lists Works with Alexa for the doorbell, and Ring's Alexa page says all Ring video doorbell models work with Alexa.

smartthings.note: No official Ring or SmartThings page found for this model.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Ring integration lists 'Battery Doorbell' and 'Doorbell 3 Plus', not the Battery Doorbell Plus, so support isn't confirmed.

hubRequired.note: Connects over Wi-Fi; a Ring Chime is optional and no hub is mentioned.

localControl.note: Ring does not state whether any control works without its cloud.

power.note: Removable Quick Release Battery Pack. It can also be hardwired to an existing doorbell wire with an 8-24 VAC transformer to keep the pack charged; Ring lists a Solar Charger for Battery Doorbells as a compatible accessory.

localStorage.note: Neither Ring page states a local recording option.

subscription.value: Smart alerts and video features (Ring Protect plan)
subscription.note: Ring says features such as Smart Alerts, Extended Live View, Video Search and 180-day video history need a compatible Ring plan; the pages do not say whether any recording works without one.

summary: Ring says its Battery Doorbell 2K Plus works with Alexa, over dual-band Wi-Fi with no hub. The pack is rechargeable and removable, or the doorbell can be hardwired to keep it charged. Smart Alerts, Video Search and longer video history need a Ring plan. Apple Home, Google Home and SmartThings aren't confirmed.
caveats: Smart Alerts, Extended Live View, Video Search and video history of up to 180 days need a compatible Ring Protect plan.
Home Assistant's Ring integration doesn't list this model by name.
Apple Home, Google Home and SmartThings support is not confirmed.
